patch: UPDATE transactions SET amount = amount * 2 WHERE id = (SELECT t.id FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id WHERE a.user_email = :email AND t.amount < 0 AND lower(t.description) NOT LIKE '%transfer%' AND lower(t.description) NOT LIKE '%payment%' ORDER BY t.amount ASC LIMIT 1)
